summary: REFACTOR REGRESSION TEST — server.py was split from 1431 lines into a modular structure (server.py 63 lines + db.py + security.py + schemas.py + seed.py + 7 routers). Zero regressions detected. Ran full pytest suite (58 tests) — 50 pass / 8 fail, and the 8 failures are IDENTICAL to the pre-existing failures documented in iteration_2 (Karimunjawa featured trip is booked_seats=25/25 → 'Sisa kuota hanya 0'; all cascade from that one). Every endpoint referenced in the refactor works at the same URL: auth (register/login/logout/me + httpOnly cookies persist), catalog (destinations/trips/featured/trips/{id}/coupons/validate), bookings (create + payment-proof upload), community (list/detail/join/leave/membership/posts/like/events/rsvp), rental (list + category+location filters + detail + orders create + orders/mine correctly resolves BEFORE /rentals/{rid}), admin (stats + trip CRUD + booking verify + community CRUD + rental CRUD + rental-orders status), midtrans (config + snap-token + notification + status). Frontend smoke: homepage loads 6 featured trip cards, /explore + /communities (Pendaki Semeru visible) + /rental (items with Rp price) all render, admin login → /admin dashboard shows Total Booking=8, Total User=10, Total Trip=6, Revenue=Rp3.645.000, and sidebar (Booking / Verifikasi Bayar / Katalog Trip / Komunitas / Rental) is intact.

minor.issue: PRE-EXISTING (not caused by refactor) — 8 test failures in TestBookingsFlow + TestBookingValidation.test_booking_flat_coupon all cascade from featured_trip[0] (Snorkeling Karimunjawa 3H2M) having booked_seats=25/25 in the seed DB. Refactored code returns the expected 400 'Sisa kuota hanya 0'; then dependent tests skip booking_id and cascade to 404/500. Same 8 failures noted in iteration_1 + iteration_2. Fix: either point booking tests at a different (non-full) featured trip index, or add an admin 'reset seat count' endpoint / seed a reserved 'test-only' trip.

When booking_id is None (cascade), endpoint returns 500 (ObjectId(None) InvalidId). Not a refactor issue — same behavior as pre-refactor; test failure only, not user-reachable. Optional hardening: try/except ObjectId(booking_id) → 404 in the admin verify_payment router (routers/admin.py L86 + L92).

action_items: NO refactor regressions to fix. Refactor is functionally identical to the monolith.
OPTIONAL (carry-over from iteration_1/2): reset booked_seats on 'Snorkeling Karimunjawa 3H2M' or move booking tests to a different trip so TestBookingsFlow (8 tests) can pass again.

OPTIONAL hardening: guard ObjectId() calls in routers/admin.py verify_payment + update_booking_status + update_rental_order with try/except → 404 to avoid 500 on malformed IDs (routers/bookings.py + routers/catalog.py + routers/rental.py already do this correctly on GET endpoints).
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: server.py is now a clean 63-line entrypoint. Concerns separated cleanly across db.py / security.py / schemas.py / seed.py / routers/*.
GOOD: route-ordering conflict avoided — /rentals/orders/mine is declared BEFORE /rentals/{rid} within routers/rental.py (line 30 vs 88). Confirmed via curl and 4 dedicated pytest cases.

GOOD: auth cookies flow cross-router — logged-in traveler session hits /api/bookings, /api/communities/{id}/join, /api/rentals/orders identically, because get_current_user in security.py is the single source of truth.
GOOD: seed_all() still runs at startup (server.py L57) and populated 6 destinations, 6+ trips, 6 communities, 10 rentals, 2 users, 2 coupons — verified via /api endpoints.
GOOD: all insert_one → response paths correctly pop('_id') (auth.register uses clean_user; bookings/community/rental/admin routers all pop before spreading). No ObjectId leaks detected.

MINOR: routers/admin.py verify_payment doesn't wrap ObjectId(booking_id) in try/except, so a malformed ID → 500. Same for admin_update_community / admin_update_rental / update_booking_status. Not a regression, but pre-existing hardening gap.

MINOR: server.py CORS uses FRONTEND_URL with allow_credentials=True, but falls back to allow_origins=['*'] when FRONTEND_URL is unset — that combo is invalid per spec (browsers reject credentialed CORS with wildcard). Works right now because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is same-origin via the ingress rewrite, but a stricter env should set FRONTEND_URL explicitly.
MINOR: routers/community.py leave_community doesn't clamp member_count >= 0 — repeated leave calls would $inc it negative. Not a refactor regression.

success_rate.backend: 86% (50/58); the 8 failing are pre-existing seed-exhaustion failures unrelated to the refactor. 100% of NEW/REFACTORED endpoints (community 15/15 + rental 11/11 + admin 3/3 + auth 8/8 + coupons 4/4 + catalog 8/8 + admin_stats 2/2) pass.

seed_data_creation: No new seed created. Pytest created some TEST_ prefixed community posts/events + rental orders on the traveler + admin sessions and cleaned up all admin CRUD entities (verified via GET → 404 in tests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The refactor is CLEAN. Structure to remember: /app/backend/{server.py, db.py, security.py, schemas.py, seed.py} + /app/backend/routers/{auth,catalog,bookings,community,rental,admin,payments}.py. Pytest config still uses -n 2 --dist loadscope (/app/backend/pytest.ini). When running booking creation tests, avoid featured_trip[0]='Snorkeling Karimunjawa 3H2M' — it's still 25/25 full. Use a different trip index or a fresh seed. Route ordering: /rentals/orders/mine must remain BEFORE /rentals/{rid} in routers/rental.py (currently L30 vs L88 — do NOT reorder).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bug found. The 8 pytest failures in TestBookingsFlow + TestBookingValidation.test_booking_flat_coupon are pre-existing seed-state carryover from iteration_1 (Karimunjawa featured trip fully booked). Refactor introduced zero functional changes; all endpoint URLs, response shapes, auth behavior, and cross-router cookie handling verified identical.
